## Core Services

SKYON operates as a full-stack engineering and digital growth partner, eliminating disconnected vendors and bloated software:

1. **Website Development** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/website-development)
   Handcrafted, high-performance static and dynamic web applications built with modern frameworks (Astro, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript). Zero bloatware, sub-second load times, and perfect Core Web Vitals.
2. **Custom Software Development** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/custom-software)
   Tailored internal portals, business workflow software, ERP modules, role-based dashboards, and scalable database systems engineered for exact business logic.
3. **Cloud Solutions & Infrastructure** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/cloud-solutions)
   Multi-region cloud infrastructure, serverless edge delivery, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated database backups, and AWS/Cloudflare architecture.
4. **AI & Automation Integration** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/ai-automation)
   Practical workflow automation, webhook routing, WhatsApp Business lead capture funnels, document parsing, and domain-governed AI assistants grounded strictly in business data.
5. **UI/UX Product Design** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/ui-ux-design)
   User-centered interface design, interactive Figma prototypes, design token systems, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards engineered for high conversion.
6. **IT Consulting & Strategy** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/it-consulting)
   Independent technical advisory, legacy codebase architecture audits, vendor governance, and build-vs-buy roadmaps to eliminate technical liabilities.
7. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/seo)
   Technical SEO audits, machine-readable JSON-LD Schema markup, Core Web Vitals optimization, and Google Local 3-Pack rank dominance.
8. **Digital Marketing & Growth** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/digital-marketing)
   High-ROI Google Search and Meta Ads campaigns, Click-to-WhatsApp conversion funnels, and clear ROAS attribution tracking.
9. **Social Media Management** (https://skyonitsolutions.com/services/social-media)
   B2B LinkedIn thought leadership, educational Instagram carousels, and consistent brand storytelling that builds corporate authority.

## Blog & Engineering Guides

SKYON publishes practical, grounded technical guides for founders, engineering teams, and operations managers:

- [Why technical SEO matters before spending money on search ads](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/technical-seo-checklist-for-growing-businesses): Fix crawl errors, structured data, and mobile load speed first, so paid traffic and organic visitors actually find and trust your website.
- [How to get your business cited in AI search answers and Google Overviews](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/generative-engine-optimization-for-small-business): Practical guide to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) so AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite and recommend your services.
- [Five practical UX changes that turn casual website visitors into WhatsApp inquiries](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/ui-ux-design-principles-that-drive-inquiries): Actionable design improvements to visual hierarchy, mobile thumb zones, and direct inquiry buttons that boost visitor conversion.
- [Plan a business website around what visitors need to do](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/plan-a-business-website): How to shape site navigation, service clarity, accessibility, and maintenance requirements around visitor goals.
- [When should a business consider custom software?](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/when-custom-software-makes-sense): Objective comparison of buying SaaS vs. building bespoke software, evaluating workflows and ownership costs.
- [A careful starting point for an AI or automation project](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/start-an-automation-project): Guidelines on selecting bounded tasks, keeping human-in-the-loop review, and handling exceptions safely.
- [How workflow automation reduces operational overhead for SMEs](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/workflow-automation-for-growing-businesses): Identifying administrative bottlenecks, connecting existing CRM/messaging APIs, and building reliable audit logs.
- [A practical checklist before migrating applications to the cloud](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/cloud-infrastructure-checklist): Essential checklist covering right-sized compute, staging isolation, encrypted secrets, and graceful degradation.
- [What custom software really costs to build, deploy, and maintain](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/what-custom-software-costs-to-build-and-maintain): Transparent total cost of ownership (TCO) breakdown covering upfront builds, database hosting, API fees, and maintenance debt.
- [What the first six months of technical SEO actually look like for growing businesses](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/what-the-first-six-months-of-seo-look-like): Month-by-month timeline explaining crawl fixes, schema indexing, impression surges, and inquiry conversions.
- [AI search optimization for real estate and high-ticket service companies](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/ai-search-optimization-for-real-estate-and-high-ticket-services): How developers, luxury consultants, and corporate service providers get cited and recommended when buyers prompt ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI.
- [A pragmatic cybersecurity and backup checklist for growing tech teams](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/cybersecurity-and-backup-checklist-for-growing-teams): Essential safeguards including automated immutable snapshots, quarterly restore drills, staging isolation, and secret management.
- [How Indian tech agencies can build credibility and win clients in the US, UK, and UAE](https://skyonitsolutions.com/blog/how-indian-tech-companies-win-clients-in-us-uk-uae): Strategies for overcoming cross-border trust hurdles: guaranteed time-zone overlap, localized pricing milestones, and rapid WhatsApp communication.
